title: Enlargement by scale factor −2
caption: Each coordinate is multiplied by −2: (1, 1) → (−2, −2), (3, 1) → (−6, −2), (1, 2) → (−2, −4). The image is twice the size, on the other side of the origin and turned through 180°.
alt: Triangle A with vertices (1, 1), (3, 1), (1, 2) and its image B, twice the size on the opposite side of the origin.
description: Enlarging by −2 about the origin multiplies every coordinate by −2.
The image B has vertices (−2, −2), (−6, −2) and (−2, −4): twice as big, inverted through the origin.
